description: Figure 1 is a horizontal bar chart titled "Number of tasks by language family." The chart displays the number of tasks for ten different language families, with the language families listed on the vertical axis and the number of tasks on the horizontal axis, which is labeled "# tasks" and ranges from 0 to 80. The bars are sorted in descending order of the number of tasks. The IE-Slavic family has the highest number of tasks, with a value of approximately 79. The IE-Romance family follows with about 47 tasks, and the IE-Germanic family has around 44 tasks. The remaining families have fewer tasks: IE-Baltic (approximately 17), IE-other (approximately 14), IE-Indic (approximately 10), Semitic (approximately 8), Turkic (approximately 5), and Basque (approximately 4). Each bar is a different color, and the chart visually represents a significant disparity in the number of tasks across the language families, with IE-Slavic having the most and Basque having the fewest.
